image_integration.description: Slug of a connected integration that can generate images (OpenAI Images…; Settings → Integrations).

role.description: The role the picture is attached to the entry in.

style_prefix.description: Put in front of the saved suggestion to set the look of the picture.
style_prefix.example: Documentary photograph, natural light, no text, no logos, no people's faces.

style_note.description: The look of the photo, used when the entry has no saved suggestion yet and the AI writes one. May be blank.

suggestion_key.description: The metadata key the image suggestion is saved under and read from.
